code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    p7=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==7]
    p9=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==9]
    for r,c in p9:g[r][c]=7
    if not p7 or not p9:return g
    # Mark every vacant lattice cell between the two shapes with 2.
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in p7+p9)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in p7+p9))
    same_row=max(r for r,c in p7)==max(r for r,c in p9) and min(r for r,c in p7)==min(r for r,c in p9)
    if same_row:
        rows=list(range(min(r for r,c in p7),max(r for r,c in p7)+1))
        start=max(c for r,c in p7)+1 if sum(c for r,c in p7)<sum(c for r,c in p9) else max(c for r,c in p9)+1
        end=min(c for r,c in p9) if start==max(c for r,c in p7)+1 else min(c for r,c in p7)
        # centers are separated by the observed shape pitch
        pitch=(sum(c for r,c in p9)/len(p9))-(sum(c for r,c in p7)/len(p7))
        step=round(abs(pitch)/(round(abs(pitch)/3)))
        centers=[start+(end-start-1)//2] if end-start<=3 else list(range(start+1,end,3))
        for r in rows:
            for c in centers:
                if g[r][c]==6:g[r][c]=2
    else:
        r=min(max(r for r,c in p7),max(r for r,c in p9))+1
        c=min(c for r,c in p7+p9)
        # demo's single-cell shapes meet at the central lattice cell
        for rr in range(r,r+1):
            for cc in range(c,c+1):
                if g[rr][cc]==6:g[rr][cc]=2
    return g
'''
